title: Gill's Record Double Ton Seals ODI Series for India
indian_angle: Indian skipper Shubman Gill broke the record for the fastest ODI double century, leading India to an 8-wicket victory and sealing the series against West Indies.
summary: Shubman Gill scored an unbeaten 233 off 133 balls, supported by Rohit Sharma's century, as India successfully chased down 406 against West Indies to win the second ODI and secure the series 2-0.

title: Indian Compound Archers Secure Hat-Trick of Golds at Asian Games
indian_angle: India's compound archery teams delivered a historic performance at the Asian Games, securing a hat-trick of gold medals, including a world-record win for the women's team.
summary: India's Jyothi Vennam, Chikitha Taniparthi, and Prithika Pradeep defended their Asian Games compound archery gold with a world-record 238-234 win over China, contributing to India's three gold medals in the discipline.

title: Neeru-Kynan Duo Claims Trap Mixed Team Shooting Gold at Asian Games
indian_angle: The Indian shooting pair of Neeru and Kynan secured a gold medal in the trap mixed team event at the Asian Games 2026, adding to India's impressive tally.
summary: The Indian team of Neeru and Kynan shot a score of 34 in the final to claim the trap mixed team gold at the Asian Games 2026, defeating Qatar.

title: Indian Women's Hockey Team Reaches Asian Games Final
indian_angle: India's women's hockey team broke through a strong Korean defense to secure their spot in the Asian Games final, moving one step closer to gold.
summary: Goals from Ishika and Salima in quick succession allowed the Indian women's hockey team to defeat a stubborn Korean defense and advance to the final of the Asian Games 2026.
